miniapp.name: Letters to the Future
miniapp.subtitle: Messages for the unknown future
miniapp.description: A permanent on-chain message board on Base mainnet. Leave a message for someone you'll never meet, in a time you'll never see. Features include time capsules (locked messages), anonymous mode, NFT minting, and a daily featured letter.
miniapp.ogDescription: Permanent messages on Base — for someone you'll never meet, in a time you'll never see
